ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black) to 30% high-intensity (white) distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary white pigmentation zones. The left lobe contains a fragmented, feathered white patch on its outer half. The right lobe contains a larger, more contiguous elongated white patch with a singular dark focal spot near the upper trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex angle and deep indentation relative to the fluke's central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with moderate pixel-amplitude variation. Multiple jagged peaks and valleys are clearly defined against the water background along the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to the distal tips, showing a consistent outward arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast light pixels (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme outer tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed crossing the white pigmentation patch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustations on distal tips and a distinct dark circular mark within the white field of the right lobe lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe features a unique ocellus-like (eye-shaped) dark spot within its primary white pigmentation field.
